title: PMM3 vs MLE-TN: code and stored results
description:
R code and stored Monte Carlo results for the paper PMM3 vs MLE-TN: Comparison of Semiparametric and Parametric Estimation of Linear Regression Parameters under Two-piece Normal Distributed Errors (S. Zabolotnii, A. Chepynoha, P. Klopotovskyi; submitted to ITEST 2026).

The archive compares the third-order polynomial maximization method (PMM3), maximum likelihood for the Two-piece Normal distribution (MLE-TN) and OLS for linear regression with symmetric platykurtic errors. It contains the full Monte Carlo table (24 scenarios × 4 estimators, M = 500), the theoretical efficiency table, the misspecification and bimodal-convergence tests, the real-data results, and the scripts that regenerate the paper's figures and tables. scripts/verify_stored_results.R reruns the simulation (seed 20260312) and checks it against the stored tables.
